faqs.question: How much does a backyard transformation cost?
faqs.answer: Most backyard projects in our area range from $8,000 to $40,000 depending on size, materials, and scope. We give you a firm written quote after the free yard assessment so you know the exact number before any work starts.

faqs.question: Do you offer financing?
faqs.answer: Yes. We work with several financing partners so you can spread the cost over 12 to 60 months. Ask us about current rates when you call for your free estimate.

faqs.question: What if I need to change the design after we start?
faqs.answer: Any change to scope gets a written change order with an updated price before we touch anything. You approve it first. No surprises.

faqs.question: How long does a typical installation take?
faqs.answer: A patio or planting bed project typically takes 2 to 5 days. A full backyard transformation can take 1 to 3 weeks. We give you a timeline in writing as part of your proposal.

faqs.question: What do I need to do before the crew arrives?
faqs.answer: Clear access to the work area and make sure any gates or doors are unlocked. We handle the rest. We will walk you through the pre-visit checklist when we confirm your start date.

faqs.question: What happens if something gets damaged during the project?
faqs.answer: We are fully insured. Any damage caused by our crew is covered and repaired at our expense. We can provide our certificate of insurance before work starts.

faqs.question: Can I see photos of your past work before I decide?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our gallery shows real projects with investment ranges and locations. We can also share additional photos from specific neighborhoods or project types when you call.

faqs.question: What is included in weekly lawn care?
faqs.answer: Mowing, edging, blowing off hard surfaces, and a quality check at the end of every visit. Fertilization, weed control, and seasonal cleanups are add-on services we can quote separately.
